title: SpaceX Delivers Unfortunate News for Verizon, ATT, T-Mobile, and AST Space Mobile Stock Investors
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc reacts to SpaceX's late-Thursday announcement that it will acquire nationwide low-band spectrum, positioning Starlink to challenge legacy wireless carriers — AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile each fell over 10%, with AST SpaceMobile down over 20%. He treats the dip as opportunity for the incumbents but not for ASTS. TMUS (BUY at ~$149, first tracked call) trades near its 52-week low vs his $223 DCF fair value. VZ (BUY at ~$41, reiterated) offers a 28% margin of safety to his $53 fair value even with some share loss, plus a dividend angle for income investors. T (BUY at ~$22, reiterated) trades well below his $30+ intrinsic value; he cites AT&T's CEO arguing Starlink's threat stays niche (rural, aviation, IoT). ASTS (AVOID at ~$50, first tracked call) still sits above his $35 intrinsic value despite the drop — he has warned all year that it is overvalued and sees more downside before it becomes buyable. Calls: TMUS/VZ/T BUY, ASTS AVOID.
